title: Signature Move
body:
Syntax: signature  |  signature <move name>  |  signature clear

Choose one eligible, learned active combat jutsu after it reaches 100% proficiency. Normal practice still stops at 50%; reach 100% through use first. Once selected, practice that move with a matching teacher to raise its cap to 150%. The bonus begins only at 150%: +25% damage for an attack, and +25% duration for status/utility effects (Chisei also boosts its temporary Chakra). Switch or clear the signature whenever you want, but the old move immediately drops back to 100%. A newly chosen move starts its own 100%-150% training. Passive, binary, and other unsupported abilities cannot be selected.

Date: 2026-10-06
